_snapshot.label: MacroChipz #52A Rates World prototype snapshot
_snapshot.purpose: Frozen copy of real API responses so the standalone prototype renders published values only. NOT live data. NOT a MacroChipz publication.
_snapshot.note: Every number the prototype draws is copied verbatim from these responses. The prototype performs no economic arithmetic.

monitors_rates.attribution: Source: U.S. Department of the Treasury (Daily Treasury Par Yield Curve Rates).

provenance.calculation: UST_NOMINAL_10Y - UST_NOMINAL_2Y, in basis points, on one exactly-shared observation date
UST_NOMINAL_30Y - UST_NOMINAL_2Y, in basis points, on one exactly-shared observation date
UST_NOMINAL_5Y - UST_REAL_5Y, in percentage points, on one exactly-shared observation date; market-implied compensation, not an inflation forecast
UST_NOMINAL_10Y - UST_REAL_10Y, in percentage points, on one exactly-shared observation date; market-implied compensation, not an inflation forecast

limitations: Carries no significance claim: rates_v1.0 defines no notability threshold, so this reports the movement and its own historical position, not that the movement matters.
Change windows are counted in trading SESSIONS, never calendar days.

Treasury observations are stored under MacroChipz's own series identifiers, so `provider_series_id` here is the stored identifier rather than Treasury's own XML field name; that field is recorded in observation_provenance.source_series_field. See docs/architecture/economic-concept-identity.md section 6.
